models.description: Elevated feelings brought forward from the BR sidecut fish featuring the edge design of George Greenough, giving an enhanced flavour of what already was… improved manoeuvrability, speed of which feels unrestricted, added lift also provides a more positive feeling through turns, that flow easier than ever. models.name: Brahman
models.description: Something a little different from your traditional log with the Brahman here. Taking nose riding design theories and putting them together in an alternative way to give a nicely balance blend of tip time and turn ability. A thinner nose than a lot of nose riders, which rely on the volume and surface area up front.
